name: 11365 · Fresh Meadows, NY
findings: ZIP 11365 (Fresh Meadows) has 113 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11365 (Fresh Meadows) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
100% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
